name: Website Content Crawler
description: Crawl websites and extract text content from web pages. Supports crawling of JavaScript-heavy sites using headless Chrome/Firefox browser. Extracts text, markdown, or HTML from each page.

inputSchema.title: Website Content Crawler
inputSchema.description: Crawl websites and extract text content from web pages.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: One or more URLs where the crawler will start. Each URL must be a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL.

crawlerType.title: Crawler type
crawlerType.description: Select the crawling engine. 'playwright:firefox' is the default. 'cheerio' is the fastest but can't handle JavaScript-rendered content. 'playwright:adaptive' automatically switches between Cheerio and Playwright based on page complexity.

maxCrawlDepth.title: Max crawling depth
maxCrawlDepth.description: Specifies how many links away from the startUrls the crawler will descend. '0' means only start URLs, '1' means start URLs and their direct links, etc.

maxCrawlPages.title: Max pages
maxCrawlPages.description: Maximum number of pages that the crawler will open. 0 means unlimited. The crawl will stop when this limit is reached.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of results (pages) that will be saved to the dataset. The crawl will stop when this limit is reached. 0 means unlimited.

includeUrlGlobs.title: Include URLs (Glob patterns)
includeUrlGlobs.description: Glob patterns to match links in the page that will be enqueued. Combine with 'Exclude URLs' to fine-tune the crawling scope.

excludeUrlGlobs.title: Exclude URLs (Glob patterns)
excludeUrlGlobs.description: Glob patterns to match links in the page that will NOT be enqueued.

initialCookies.title: Initial cookies
initialCookies.description: JSON array of cookie objects to be set before the first page is loaded.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Specifies proxy servers that will be used by the crawler.

removeElementsCssSelector.title: Remove HTML elements (CSS selector)
removeElementsCssSelector.description: CSS selector matching HTML elements that should be removed from the page before extracting text content. Use commas to separate multiple selectors.
removeElementsCssSelector.default: nav, footer, script, style, noscript, svg, img[src^='data:']

htmlTransformer.title: HTML Transformer
htmlTransformer.description: Determines how HTML is transformed to text output.

url.description: The URL of the crawled page

depth.description: Depth of the page from the start URL

httpStatusCode.description: HTTP status code of the response

text.description: Extracted text content from the page

markdown.description: Markdown representation of the page content
